chunks: Intimate relations become permissible in three ways: marriage with inheritance, marriage without inheritance, and marriage by right-hand possession (concubinage).

No one has guardianship over a woman except her father, so long as she is a virgin. If she has previously been married, then no one has guardianship over her; neither her father nor anyone else may marry her off except to one she herself consents to, with a stipulated dower.

Divorce cannot occur except in accordance with the Book and the Sunnah. There is no oath in divorce nor in manumission. There is no divorce before marriage. There is no manumission before ownership. And there is no manumission except for what is intended thereby to be for the sake of God, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.البكر: A virgin; a woman who has not previously consummated a marriage
key_terms.الثيب: A non-virgin; a woman who has previously consummated a marriage (includes divorcees and widows)
key_terms.الصداق المفروض: The obligatory dower; the mahr that is stipulated in the marriage contract
key_terms.العتق: Manumission; the freeing of a slave
key_terms.الفروج: Intimate relations; sexual intercourse — legally significant term in fiqh
key_terms.الولاية: Guardianship; the legal right to contract marriage on behalf of another
key_terms.ملك اليمين: Right-hand possession; concubinage; ownership of a female slave for intimate relations

ai.seo_question: What are the three forms of licit marriage in Shia Islamic law?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq sets forth foundational principles of Islamic family law: three forms of licit sexual relations, the conditions for paternal guardianship (wilaya) over women and when it lapses upon non-virginity, the requirement of a woman's consent and a stipulated mahr, the requirement that divorce conform to Quran and Sunnah, and the invalidity of oaths in divorce or manumission, as well as conditions prerequisite to their validity.

en.bilal-muhammad: Intercourse becomes permissible in three scenarios: marriage with inheritance, marriage without inheritance, and intercourse with concubines.

No one has a right to a woman except through her father when she is a virgin. If she has consummated [an Islamic marriage before], then no one has guardianship over here; neither her father nor anyone else can marry her off without her [expressed] consent and an obligatory dower.

Divorce cannot take place except upon the Quran and the Sunna. There is no oath in divorce nor in manumission. There is no divorce prior to marriage. There is no manumission prior to ownership. There is no manumission except for the sake of Allah.
